company.title: Company
company.description: ARMATIS is an Italian yacht builder creating high-quality motor yachts through a modern, industrial approach — designed, engineered and built in-house in Italy.

manufacturing.title: Manufacturing
manufacturing.description: Inside the ARMATIS production platform — dedicated facilities, advanced composite manufacturing, robotics and in-house R&D.

contact.title: Contact

brand.positioning: ARMATIS is an Italian yacht builder focused on creating high-quality motor yachts through a modern and industrial approach to yacht manufacturing.
brand.vision: Our vision is built around in-house production, process control, and sustainable long-term quality. By combining advanced composite technologies, engineering-driven development, and carefully structured production methods, we aim to deliver yachts with consistent build quality and exceptional reliability.
brand.spaces: ARMATIS is also focused on rethinking onboard living spaces. Our yachts are designed to offer exceptional volumes, intelligent layouts, and a new interpretation of comfort and usability — moving beyond conventional standards in their category while maintaining elegant and balanced proportions.
brand.production: Rather than relying only on traditional craftsmanship, ARMATIS is developing a scalable production system designed to maintain the same level of precision, finish, and engineering quality from the first yacht to every yacht that follows.
brand.closing: Based in Italy, ARMATIS combines timeless design, modern engineering, and manufacturing expertise to create yachts that offer performance, comfort, durability, and refined simplicity.

vision.label: Vision
vision.title: Designed, Engineered & Built in Italy
vision.body: ARMATIS creates high-quality motor yachts through a modern, industrial approach — advanced composite technologies, engineering-driven development and a scalable production system that holds the same precision, finish and reliability from the first yacht to every yacht that follows.

salon.label: Interiors — Main salon
salon.caption: An open main-deck salon framed by full-height panoramic glazing.

interiors.label: Interiors
interiors.title: Volume, used with intent
interiors.body: A full-beam main salon, a master suite that runs the width of the hull, and a beach club that opens the hull directly onto the water. Interiors are engineered and fitted in-house, held to the same tolerances as the structure behind them.

exteriors.label: Exteriors
exteriors.title: A profile drawn for the sea
exteriors.body: Long, low and unbroken from bow to stern — with deck spaces that stay usable rather than decorative: a foredeck spa, a shaded aft deck, and a bathing platform at sea level.

yacht.label: The 107
yacht.title: Thirty metres, redefined
yacht.body: Engineered volumes, intelligent layouts and a quiet, assured presence at sea — the ARMATIS 107 moves beyond the conventions of its class while keeping every proportion in balance.

mould.title: Model & Mould
mould.blurb: Five-axis CNC machining and large-format 3D printing produce high-precision plugs and composite moulds — complete tooling independence.

lamination.title: Composite Lamination
lamination.blurb: Hull, superstructure and deck are built with advanced lamination and vacuum-infusion technologies.

assembly.title: Assembly & Outfitting
assembly.blurb: Propulsion, technical systems and interiors are installed and commissioned in a dedicated outfitting facility.

company.quote: Industrial discipline, advanced technology and long-term vision — in the service of timeless Italian yachts.

solar.label: Solar & silent power
solar.body: An integrated 7.5 kW solar array with battery-supported hotel loads dramatically reduces generator hours — quieter nights at anchor, lower emissions, less noise.

stability.label: Digital stability monitoring
stability.body: A patented onboard system continuously reads trim and inclination, giving guests and crew real-time awareness of the vessel's balance.

platform.label: Deployable platform
platform.body: A patented, space-efficient deployable platform transforms otherwise unused internal volume into functional exterior living space.

interiors.label: Modular interiors
interiors.body: Pre-engineered aluminium interior structures replace traditional carpentry — precision-built in the workshop and installed in a fraction of the time.

hero.label: Company
hero.title: An industrial approach to Italian yacht building

story.label: The company
story.title: Every stage, under one roof
story.body: ARMATIS designs, engineers and builds its yachts entirely in-house — from tooling and composite structures to systems, interiors and commissioning. Controlling every core stage of production within one operational structure is how we guarantee consistent quality, dependable delivery and a build standard that does not vary from hull to hull.

epicentre.label: The epicentre
epicentre.body: Italy is the global centre of excellence for yacht design and construction — home to the standards the industry measures itself against.

ecosystem.label: The ecosystem
ecosystem.body: A unique network of specialised suppliers, skilled craftspeople and nautical know-how surrounds every stage of the build.

madeInItaly.label: Made in Italy
madeInItaly.body: At its shipyard in Brindisi, ARMATIS builds fully in Italy — contributing to the industry it belongs to, for the long term.

company.positioning: ARMATIS stands for a new interpretation of Italian yacht manufacturing — built on industrial discipline, advanced technology, research and long-term vision.

facilities.label: Production model
facilities.title: Three facilities. One integrated flow.
facilities.intro: Every core stage of construction — from tooling to launch — is carried out within ARMATIS' own production system, under one engineering standard.

mould.title: Model & Mould Manufacturing
mould.body: High-precision plugs and composite moulds produced with five-axis CNC machining and large-format 3D printing — the strategic asset that guarantees tooling independence and repeatable geometry.

lamination.title: Composite Lamination
lamination.body: Hull, superstructure and deck are laminated in a dedicated facility using advanced infusion technologies, engineered for large structural components.

assembly.title: Assembly & Outfitting
assembly.body: Propulsion, mechanical, electrical and hydraulic systems, interiors and final commissioning — completed in a facility reserved exclusively for outfitting.

one.label: Phase I
one.body: Initial production — process stabilisation, team development and supplier integration around the first hulls.

two.label: Phase II
two.body: Progressive growth — capacity expands in step with demand, organisational maturity and industrial efficiency.

three.label: Phase III
three.body: Full industrial regime — parallel production lines and an optimised workforce, holding the same standard as hull number one.

cadcam.detail: From model to mould, without translation loss

interiors.title: Modular aluminium interiors
interiors.body: Pre-engineered structural frameworks and workshop-built furniture replace onboard carpentry — plug-and-install precision with dramatically shorter installation times.

harness.title: Engineered electrical architecture
harness.body: Automotive-inspired, fully pre-assembled harness systems reduce onboard wiring time, lower error rates and standardise serial production.

composites.title: Advanced composite R&D
composites.body: A structured research programme pursuing lighter, stronger structures through hybrid laminates and optimised infusion.

lab.title: In-house testing laboratory
lab.body: Tensile, flexural and laminate validation on site — every structural decision backed by measured data.

green.label: Sustainable manufacturing
green.title: Built with renewable energy
green.body: Production runs on renewable energy from a rooftop photovoltaic system, with advanced ventilation and carbon filtration ensuring clean, controlled composite processes — a facility aligned with the European Green Deal.
green.productLead: The same philosophy sails with every yacht

rnd.label: R&D & collaboration
rnd.title: Engineering that never stands still
rnd.body: An in-house engineering centre dedicated to hull forms, advanced composite structures, lightweight construction and digital simulation — developed in structured collaboration with Italian universities and research centres, from joint projects to talent programmes.

platforms.label: Platform range
platforms.title: A family, engineered from one system

privacy.title: Privacy & Data Protection
privacy.updated: Information notice pursuant to the GDPR

controller.head: Data Controller
controller.body: The data controller is ARMATIS S.R.L., registered office Via Dante 4, 20121 Milan (MI), Italy, VAT no. 14497620964. For any matter relating to your personal data you may contact us at info@armatisyachts.com.

collect.head: Information We Collect
collect.body: When you submit the enquiry form we collect only the data you provide: first name, last name, e-mail address, telephone number (optional), enquiry type and the content of your message. We do not collect special categories of personal data, and the website does not use tracking or advertising cookies.

purpose.head: Purpose & Legal Basis
purpose.body: Your data is processed for the sole purpose of receiving, managing and responding to your enquiry. The legal basis is your consent, freely given when you tick the consent box (Article 6(1)(a) of Regulation (EU) 2016/679, the “GDPR”).

processing.head: Processing & Storage
processing.body: Your enquiry is delivered by e-mail through our processor Resend, and this website is hosted by Vercel; both process data on secure infrastructure, with delivery handled within the European Union. Your data is never sold, rented or shared with third parties for marketing purposes.

retention.head: Data Retention
retention.body: Your personal data is retained only for the time strictly necessary to handle your enquiry and any related correspondence, after which it is deleted or anonymised.

rights.head: Your Rights
rights.body: You have the right to access, rectify, erase or restrict the processing of your data, to object to processing, to data portability, and to withdraw your consent at any time without affecting the lawfulness of prior processing. You may also lodge a complaint with the Italian Supervisory Authority (Garante per la protezione dei dati personali).

contact.head: Contact
contact.body: To exercise your rights or for any question regarding this notice, please write to info@armatisyachts.com.

cookies.title: Cookie notice
cookies.body: We use only the essential cookies required for language and display preferences — no tracking or advertising. See our Privacy Policy for details.
